general_survival_faqs.question: How do I connect to campus Wi-Fi?
general_survival_faqs.answer: Most universities use an enterprise WPA2 secure network (e.g., [Campus]-Secure). Log in using your student email or ID credentials. For gaming consoles or devices without browsers, register the MAC address through your institution's IT portal.

general_survival_faqs.question: What should I do if I misplace my student ID card?
general_survival_faqs.answer: Immediately report your card lost through your college student portal or ID services office to freeze card-linked dining funds and building access. Visit your campus ID office or security post for a reissued card.

general_survival_faqs.question: How do course add/drop deadlines work?
general_survival_faqs.answer: Institutions typically allow students to adjust courses during the first 1-2 weeks of classes without academic penalty. Always verify the exact deadline on your college registrar calendar and consult your advisor before dropping below minimum full-time credit limits.

general_survival_faqs.question: Where can I find free academic tutoring or writing help?
general_survival_faqs.answer: Check your library or student learning center for peer tutoring, math labs, and writing centers. Most services are included in your student tuition and offer both drop-in hours and appointment bookings.
